at yde.explanation: "At yde" means "to provide". To say you give support: "yde støtte" (provide support). To say you try hard: "yde en indsats" (make an effort).

sentence.da: Kommunen skal **yde** hjælp til familier i nød.
sentence.en: The municipality must provide help to families in need.

at ytre.explanation: "At ytre" means "to express". To say someone says what they think: "Hun ytrer sin mening" (She voices her opinion). The noun is "en ytring" (a statement).

sentence.da: Alle må gerne **ytre** deres mening i et frit land.
sentence.en: Everyone may express their opinion in a free country.

en yderside.explanation: "En yderside" means "an outside". To say how the outside of an object looks: "Kassens yderside er blå" (The outside of the box is blue). For the other side, use "en inderside" (an inside): "Kopens inderside er hvid" (The inside of the cup is white).

sentence.da: Vi maler husets **yderside** i dag.
sentence.en: We are painting the outside of the house today.

en yndlingsbog.explanation: "En yndlingsbog" means "a favorite book". The start "yndlings-" means "favorite" in other words too, such as "min yndlingsmad" (my favorite food).

sentence.da: Jeg har læst min **yndlingsbog** mange gange.
sentence.en: I have read my favorite book many times.

en yndlingsfarve.explanation: "En yndlingsfarve" means "a favorite color". It is built from "yndling" (favorite) and "farve" (color). The same start is in "mit yndlingsdyr" (my favorite animal).

sentence.da: Min **yndlingsfarve** er grøn, og min søsters er blå.
sentence.en: My favorite color is green, and my sister's is blue.

en yndlingsfilm.explanation: "En yndlingsfilm" means "a favorite movie". The start "yndlings-" means "favorite" in other words too, such as "min yndlingsskuespiller" (my favorite actor).

sentence.da: Min **yndlingsfilm** er meget gammel, men jeg elsker den.
sentence.en: My favorite movie is very old, but I love it.

en yndlingsret.explanation: "En yndlingsret" means "a favorite dish". It is built from "yndling" (favorite) and "ret" (dish). A different meaning of "ret" is a court of law. For example, "Han skal for retten" (He has to go to court).

sentence.da: Min **yndlingsret** er pandekager med syltetøj.
sentence.en: My favorite dish is pancakes with jam.

en yndlingssang.explanation: "En yndlingssang" means "a favorite song". The start "yndlings-" means "favorite" in other words too, such as "mit yndlingssted" (my favorite place).

sentence.da: Jeg synger min **yndlingssang** i bilen.
sentence.en: I sing my favorite song in the car.

en yogamåtte.explanation: "En yogamåtte" means "a yoga mat". It is built from "yoga" (yoga) and "måtte" (mat). The same "måtte" is in "en dørmåtte" (a doormat). To say you forgot it: "Jeg har glemt min yogamåtte" (I forgot my yoga mat).

sentence.da: Hun ruller sin **yogamåtte** ud og laver yoga.
sentence.en: She rolls out her yoga mat and does yoga.

yderligere.explanation: "Yderligere" means "further". To ask for more details: "Har du yderligere spørgsmål?" (Do you have further questions?) A different use: after a verb it means "even more": "Priserne steg yderligere" (Prices rose even more).

sentence.da: Hvis du har **yderligere** spørgsmål, kan du ringe til os.
sentence.en: If you have further questions, you can call us.

yderst.explanation: "Yderst" means "extremely". To make a word stronger: "yderst vigtigt" (extremely important). A different meaning is "outermost". For example, "yderst til venstre" (on the far left).

forms.en: at the very end of the line

sentence.da: Det er **yderst** vigtigt, at du kommer til tiden.
sentence.en: It is extremely important that you arrive on time.

ydmyg.explanation: "Ydmyg" means "humble". A different use is for simple things: "en ydmyg bolig" (a humble home).

sentence.da: Vinderen var **ydmyg** og takkede alle, der havde hjulpet hende.
sentence.en: The winner was humble and thanked everyone who had helped her.

ydre.explanation: "Ydre" means "outer". It stays the same before both kinds of words. For example, "en ydre side" (an outer side) and "et ydre lag" (an outer layer). As a noun, it means "looks". For another example, "Hun har et pænt ydre" (She has nice looks).

sentence.da: Husets **ydre** mure er hvide.
sentence.en: The outer walls of the house are white.

ymer.explanation: "Ymer" means "a Danish soured milk". To say you have a serving of it: "en skål ymer" (a bowl of ymer). It is traditionally topped with "ymerdrys", a crunchy mix of dried rye bread crumbs and sugar.

sentence.da: **Ymer** er sur og tyk, og man spiser den med en ske.
sentence.en: Ymer is sour and thick, and you eat it with a spoon.

yndlings-.explanation: "Yndlings-" means "favorite". It comes from "en yndling" (a favorite). Put it in front of a word to make a new word: "yndlingsmad" (favorite food) and "yndlingsdyr" (favorite animal).

sentence.da: Min **yndlings**farve er blå.
sentence.en: My favorite color is blue.

yngre.explanation: "Yngre" means "younger". It is the form of "ung" (young) for comparing two people. For example, "Jeg er yngre end min bror" (I am younger than my brother).

sentence.da: Min søster er **yngre** end mig.
sentence.en: My sister is younger than me.

yngst.explanation: "Yngst" means "youngest". With "the" in front, it ends in "e". For example, "den yngste" (the youngest). For only two people, use "yngre" (younger): "Jeg er yngre end min bror" (I am younger than my brother).

sentence.da: Anna er **yngst** af mine børn.
sentence.en: Anna is the youngest of my children.

ynkelig.explanation: "Ynkelig" means "pathetic". In front of a word that takes "et", add "t": "et ynkeligt syn" (a pathetic sight).

sentence.da: Det var en **ynkelig** præstation, og holdet tabte stort.
sentence.en: It was a pathetic performance, and the team lost by a lot.

yoga.explanation: "Yoga" means "yoga". To say you do it, use "at dyrke" (to practice): "Hun dyrker yoga hver morgen" (She does yoga every morning). You can also say "Jeg laver yoga" (I do yoga).

sentence.da: I **yoga** strækker man sig og trækker vejret dybt.
sentence.en: In yoga, you stretch and breathe deeply.

yoghurt.explanation: "En yoghurt" means "a yogurt". To talk about yogurt as a food, use "noget yoghurt" (some yogurt): "Vil du have noget yoghurt?" (Would you like some yogurt?)

sentence.da: **Yoghurt** er lavet af mælk.
sentence.en: Yogurt is made of milk.

ytringsfrihed.explanation: "Ytringsfrihed" means "freedom of speech". It is built from "en ytring" (a statement) and "frihed" (freedom). In Denmark, it is protected in "Grundloven" (the Constitution Act).

sentence.da: **Ytringsfrihed** betyder, at alle må sige deres mening.
sentence.en: Freedom of speech means that everyone may say what they think.
